# Maryam Fashions
Maryam Fashions is a Pakistani womenswear store offering lawn, embroidered suits, luxury pret, festive wear and wedding wear.

## Shopping
- Home: /
- New Arrivals: /collections/new-arrivals
- Luxury Lawn: /collections/luxury-lawn
- Riwaayat: /collections/riwaayat
- Sale: /collections/sale
- Search: /search

## Customer care
- Free delivery across Pakistan, typically 3–5 business days.
- Open-parcel Cash on Delivery is available where supported.
- Seven-day returns apply to eligible unused, tagged items.
- Payments: Cash on Delivery, JazzCash, Easypaisa, bank transfer, Visa and Mastercard through a Pakistani payment gateway.
- WhatsApp: +92 306 4777251
